component.name: Sciscraper
component.summary: A scientific Markdown editor with reference management and RAG assistance

description.p: Sciscraper is a scientific Markdown editor with integrated reference management and RAG writing assistance. It embeds the Ferrite editor (editing, preview, viewers, export) and the Ragrig framework (agent pane, retrieval, library) — built with Rust and egui.

ul.li: Agent pane: RAG chat against your document corpus, with hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval
Library pane: your BibTeX bibliography, one row per reference, drag-to-cite as @key or [@key]
Add PDFs or URLs; GROBID parses and merges them into the bibliography
Three view modes: Raw editing, Split view, and full WYSIWYG preview
Native Mermaid diagram rendering (flowcharts, sequence, class, state, ER, Gantt, pie charts, and more)
CSV/TSV viewer with rainbow column coloring and sorting
JSON/YAML/TOML tree viewer with collapsible nodes
Git integration with visual status indicators in the file tree
Find and replace with regex support; synchronized scrolling between editor and preview
PDF and HTML export, executable fenced code blocks, terminal, and productivity hub
Multi-language interface support; Zen mode for distraction-free writing

Raw editing mode with syntax highlighting

description.p: First Sciscraper release — the panes the fork adds on top of the Ferrite editor:

ul.li: Agent pane backed by ragrig: streaming RAG chat, component bar, hot-swapping
Library pane: BibTeX bibliography with drag-to-cite (@key / [@key])
GROBID ingest: add PDFs and URLs, parsed and merged into the bibliography
Focus mode and co-edit against marked passages
